decisions.summary: The ranked fix ('follow the drawing page': the hand sheets' kitchen wells moved past the bath) is not followed; the hand sheets' wells stay where drawn and 0105's drawing page records a hand-sheet seat beside the generated plans' past-the-bath seat, both GUESS.
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1. The plan's cost ground ('on no evidence') does not carry it; the purpose test does: the request is that the implementation match the research, and the record's evidence (0105: kitchen, well and bath kept together, c.1600 a bath in a corner of the doma; 0091: wells 'at the front, at the side or indoors') is not edited. 'Past the bath, as far as 20 ft out' is the drawing page's account of the generated plans' geometry in a sentence 0105 itself calls 'our reading'; correcting it to describe both seats as a GUESS makes the record describe the maps without moving the research, and moving the wells out of the kitchen would take them from the one seat the record attests indoors.

decisions.summary: The hand-sheet seat is recorded as 'inside the kitchen' (the doma named for Ochiba alone) in docs/buildings.md's Kitchen well bullet ('inside the kitchen on the hand-drawn sheets (on its doma at Ochiba)') and its Research claim, 0105's drawing page ('on the hand-drawn plans, inside the kitchen'), and the well pop-up ('inside the kitchen or past the bath'); the drawing page's comment carries 'feature 372 wave 108 impl-drift'.
decisions.why: Round 1's BLOCKED item answered as directed. The round-1 measurement found every hand sheet's well rect within its kitchen rect (Ochiba on its doma, Ubame inside the kitchen off its doma, Hayakawa in a kitchen with no doma), and no sheet changed in this diff, so 'inside the kitchen' is now true of all three and the doma is claimed only where it is drawn. Grep over the four places finds no remaining 'earth floor' or 'doma' wording for the kitchen well except the Ochiba qualifier. The comment's wave number is right: the kitchen-well found row came from wave 108's impl-drift (commit 55b30cb76, 'the wells claims on 0105 checked; two found rows'). The claim re-checked IN-STEP on the new text (claims-index note: 'Ochiba's doma is a case of "inside the kitchen"'). It remains a narrowing of the ranked fix, carried by W111-a's purpose ground.

decisions.summary: The kitchen-well claim relabeled GUESS on 0105's drawing page, its 0091 citation dropped.
decisions.why: The ranked fix asks for the GUESS label on 0105's drawing page, and ranking row 20 already found that 0091 places wells 'at the front, at the side or indoors', not by a kitchen.

decisions.why: A consequence of W111-a: 'beyond it' was true only of the generated plans; 'close by' is true of both seats and keeps 0105's kitchen-well-bath grouping.
